# Martian Dances

> > Sheet music publisher and composer portfolio featuring original orchestral works, chamber music, and arrangements by composer Saunders, including the celebrated Florence Price orchestrations.

Martian Dances is the professional website of composer Saunders, offering downloadable sheet music, PDF scores, and performance materials for orchestras, chamber ensembles, and concert bands. The catalog includes original compositions like Suite for String Orchestra and Le Voyage Dans La Lune, as well as notable arrangements of Florence Price's works performed by major orchestras.

## Key Topics

- Florence Price arrangements
- Orchestral compositions
- Chamber music
- Concert band works
- Sheet music and PDF scores
- Suite for String Orchestra
- Le Voyage Dans La Lune
- Adoration orchestrations
- Cleveland Composers Guild
- Classical composition
- Orchestral arrangements
- Salvation is Created
- Contemporary classical music

## Composer Works Catalog

- [Works - www.martiandances.com](http://www.martiandances.com/works.html): Complete catalog of original compositions and arrangements by Saunders
- [Featured Products](http://www.martiandances.com/store/c1/Featured_Products.html): Featured sheet music including Martian Dances and chamber compositions

## Orchestral Works

- [Adoration for Large Orchestra (Florence B. Price, arr. M. Saunders)](http://www.martiandances.com/store/p44/Adoration_for_Large_Orchestra_%28Florence_B._Price%2C_arr._M._Saunders%29.html): Florence Price arrangement performed by Cincinnati Symphony Orchestra
- [Adoration for Small Orchestra (Florence Price, arr. Saunders)](http://www.martiandances.com/store/p42/Adoration_for_Small_Orchestra_%28Florence_Price%2C_arr._Saunders%29.html): Florence Price arrangement for small orchestra by Saunders
- [Saunders: Suite for String Orchestra](http://www.martiandances.com/store/p8/suite-for-string-orchestra.html): Three-movement suite honoring Glass, Hovhaness, and Sibelius
- [Le Voyage Dans La Lune (Hard Copy)](http://www.martiandances.com/store/p25/Le_Voyage_Dans_La_Lune_%28Hard_Copy%29.html): Film score for Georges Melies silent film, orchestra parts included
- [Salvation is Created (2012)](http://www.martiandances.com/store/p7/Salvation_is_Created_%282012%29.html): Orchestral transcription of Pavel Tschesnokoff's choral work

## Chamber Music & Vocal Works

- [Place of the Sea Mountains](http://www.martiandances.com/store/p45/place-of-the-sea-mountains.html): Trumpet, violin, piano trio inspired by Robert Manry's Atlantic crossing
- [Short Psalms](http://www.martiandances.com/store/p46/shortpsalms.html): Five psalm settings for contralto and piano, composed for Heidi Skok

## Concert Band

- [Mysterious Marvels](http://www.martiandances.com/store/p41/Mysterious_Marvels.html): Grade 5 concert band composition, PDF score and parts available
